question:
**Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

The man felt exhausted after climbing a ______ of stairs
solution:
The correct answer is **option 4) i.e. '****flight'.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is talking about a man who was tired of climbing several stairs.
 
• Therefore, the **most appropriate word** to be filled in the blank is **'****flight'.**
 
• The word **'****flight of stairs****' means a set of stairs**, which is a **collective noun.**
 
• **Collective noun:** A noun that, despite being **singular** refers to a group of things or animals.
 
• ***Example***:
 
 
• *​To reach the top of the building you have to climb a long **flight of stairs.***
 
 
 
• Hence, the **correct answer is option 4 'flight'.**

 

**Complete Sentence:**__ *The man felt exhausted after climbing a **flight** of stairs.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Let’s look at the** meaning** of other **options:**
